title: Customer Account Administrator
description:
Customer Account Administrator

Location: Chester

We are working with a well-established and growing organisation to recruit a Customer Account Administrator. This is a busy and varied role combining high-volume sales order administration, internal account management support, and day-to-day coordination of B2 B customer requirements.

Working closely with customers and internal teams, you will help ensure accounts run smoothly, orders are processed accurately, and customers receive timely updates from order receipt through to delivery.

The role would suit a highly organised administrator with experience in sales support, customer account coordination, or B2 B order processing who enjoys taking ownership of customer requirements.

Key Responsibilities
- Administering the full sales order lifecycle, processing high volumes of B2 B customer orders from receipt through to delivery
- Providing internal account management support to key customers, handling order changes, amendments, and ongoing requirements
- Maintaining regular customer contact, providing updates and responding to order and delivery enquiries
- Processing customer forecasts and demand plans using MS Excel and SAP
- Producing and maintaining 13-week rolling forecast reports to support demand and capacity planning
- Liaising with supply chain, production, logistics, and sales teams to resolve order shortfalls and capacity constraints
- Creating and maintaining shortage lists, identifying material and stock issues and coordinating their resolution
- Managing stock control and inventory records, supporting clear stock management to prevent obsolete stock
- Ensuring all orders are entered accurately into internal systems, with a high level of attention to detail
- Maintaining customer master data and undertaking system updates to keep customer and order information accurate
- Supporting and actively participating in weekly, monthly, and quarterly demand review meetings with customers and internal stakeholders
- Recording incoming orders and daily customer call-offs within automated systems
- Proactively managing customer requirements and expectations, ensuring alignment with demand, capacity, and production plans
- Supporting continuous improvement across administrative processes and customer engagement
- Providing ad hoc administrative support as required

Candidate Requirements
- Proven experience in a busy administration, sales support, B2 B customer service, or customer account support role involving high-volume order processing
- Experience within manufacturing and/or logistics would be highly advantageous
- Strong working knowledge of MS Office, particularly Excel
- SAP experience desirable but not essential
- Confident communication skills and experience liaising with B2 B customers and internal departments
- Highly organised, with excellent attention to detail and accurate data entry skills
- Able to manage multiple customer requirements and changing priorities in a fast-paced environment
- Proactive and self-motivated, with the initiative to follow up queries and coordinate solutions

title: Finance Assistant
description:
Finance Assistant - International & Partnerships

Chester Full-time, office-based

12 Months FTC - With potentail to go Perm or apply to internal positions!

competitive + excellent benefits Study support Career development

Are you looking for a Finance role where you can learn, develop and build a genuine long-term career?

We're working with a large, highly successful UK consumer business to recruit a Finance Assistant into their International & Partnerships Finance team.

This is a brilliant opportunity to join a supportive Finance function and gain exposure to a fascinating area of the business, working alongside experienced Finance professionals and teams across the wider organisation.

You'll get involved in everything from Purchase Orders and Sales Ledger through to customer recharges, invoicing, claims and financial controls, while developing your understanding of how Finance supports international partnerships and commercial activity.

What will you be doing?
- Raising and processing Purchase Orders, ensuring accurate coding and approvals.
- Supporting Sales Ledger activities and maintaining accurate customer accounts.
- Raising customer recharges, sundry invoices and credits.
- Supporting customer claims and resolving queries.
- Responding to internal and external Finance queries professionally and promptly.
- Supporting month-end and wider Finance processes.
- Maintaining accurate records and ensuring Finance controls and procedures are followed.
- Supporting audit requirements and preparing relevant documentation.
- Working closely with colleagues across Finance and the wider business.
- Taking on additional responsibilities and learning as your knowledge develops.

What are we looking for?

You don't need to have years of Finance experience. We're looking for potential, attitude and a genuine desire to learn.

You might already have experience as an:
- Accounts Assistant
- Finance Assistant
- Sales Ledger Assistant
- Purchase Ledger Assistant
- Accounts Administrator

Or perhaps you're working in another role where you've developed strong numerical, administrative and organisational skills and now want to move into Finance.

You'll ideally have:
- Some understanding of basic accounting principles.
- Good Excel and Microsoft Office skills.
- Excellent attention to detail.
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to meet deadlines.
- Good communication skills and confidence working with different people.
- A proactive, positive approach and willingness to learn.
- AAT qualification or an interest in studying towards a professional qualification.

Experience of systems such as SAP or Dynamics would be advantageous, but training will be provided.

Why join?

This isn't simply another Finance Assistant position.

You'll be joining a large and established business where you can genuinely build your career, with the opportunity to learn from experienced Finance professionals and gain exposure to areas of Finance you may not normally see at this level.

You'll also benefit from:
- Study and development opportunities
- Annual performance-related pay review
- 33 days' holiday, increasing with service
- Pension
- Free onsite parking
- Onsite electric vehicle charging
- Subsidised staff restaurant, including a Michelin-starred chef
- Subsidised Costa Coffee
- Staff shopping discounts
- Healthcare Cash Plan
- Private health insurance
- Long-service awards
- Christmas vouchers and savings scheme

title: Interim Credit Controller
description:
The role of Interim Credit Controller involves managing and maintaining accurate financial records, ensuring timely collection of outstanding debts, and supporting the Accounting & Finance department. This temporary position is ideal for someone with a strong background in credit control within the industrial/manufacturing sector.

Client Details

This opportunity is with a well-established organisation within the industrial/manufacturing sector. The company operates as a medium-sized business and is known for its focus on operational efficiency and innovation in its field.

Description
- Manage the collection of outstanding invoices, ensuring timely payments from clients.
- Monitor and reconcile customer accounts to maintain accurate financial records.
- Investigate and resolve payment discrepancies in a professional and efficient manner.
- Communicate regularly with customers to address queries and maintain positive relationships.
- Generate and distribute customer statements and reports as required.
- Collaborate with internal teams to ensure smooth credit control processes.
- Support the Accounting & Finance department with ad-hoc administrative tasks.
- Ensure compliance with company policies and financial regulations.

Profile

A successful Interim Credit Controller should have:
- Proven experience in credit control or a related accounting role.
- Experience of using an ERP System.
- Strong knowledge of financial processes within the industrial/manufacturing sector.
- Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
- Attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple tasks effectively.
- Proficiency in accounting software and Microsoft Office, particularly Excel.

Job Offer
- An hourly rate of GBP 16.00 to 19.00, depending on experience.
- Long term interim contract 9-12 months.
- Immediate start role.
- A temporary position offering flexibility and valuable industry experience.
- An opportunity to work in Chester within the industrial/manufacturing sector.
- Free parking on site and on public transport routes.
- Exposure to a collaborative and professional work environment.

This is an excellent opportunity for a skilled Credit Controller to make a positive impact. If you meet the criteria, we encourage you to apply today!

title: Part Time Payroll Assistant
company: Adele Carr Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
Part-Time Payroll Assistant

Location: Northwich
Salary: Competitive, dependent on experience
Job Type: Permanent, Part-Time
Hours: 15 or 22.5 hours per week, over 2 or 3 days

We are currently recruiting for a Part-Time Payroll Assistant to join an established and growing professional services business in Northwich.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who already has some payroll experience and is looking to broaden their knowledge, take on more responsibility and develop their career within payroll. You'll join a supportive and experienced payroll team, with plenty of opportunity to learn and develop your skills across a varied client base.

The Role

Working as part of the payroll team, you will assist with the accurate and timely processing of payrolls for a diverse portfolio of clients. This will include weekly, fortnightly, four-weekly and monthly payrolls for sole traders, partnerships and limited companies across a range of sectors.

You will work closely with experienced payroll professionals, giving you the opportunity to develop your technical knowledge, gain exposure to different payroll requirements and build your confidence in dealing with clients and payroll queries.

Key Responsibilities
- Assist with the preparation and processing of payrolls for a portfolio of clients.
- Process payroll information accurately and ensure deadlines are met.
- Support with payroll administration, including Auto Enrolment and BACS processing.
- Respond to routine payroll queries from clients, colleagues, HMRC and other third parties.
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date payroll records.
- Assist with resolving payroll issues and escalate more complex queries when required.
- Keep up to date with payroll legislation and statutory requirements.
- Build strong and professional relationships with clients.
- Work collaboratively with the wider payroll team.
- Contribute to improving payroll processes and delivering a high level of client service.

About You

We're looking for someone with some previous payroll experience who is keen to develop and expand their skill set.

You will ideally have:
- Previous experience working in a payroll role.
- A good understanding of basic payroll processes and statutory requirements.
- Some knowledge of Auto Enrolment and statutory payments.
- Experience using payroll software; BrightPay experience would be advantageous but is not essential.
- Good attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
- Strong organisational and time-management skills.
- Good communication skills and a professional, client-focused approach.
- The ability to work independently while also being a strong team player.
- A positive attitude and genuine interest in developing a career in payroll.
- Good working knowledge of Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and Outlook.

Experience within a payroll bureau or accountancy practice would be advantageous, but candidates from an in-house payroll background will also be considered.

Why Join?

You'll be joining a supportive team where you can continue to develop your payroll experience while working with a varied client portfolio. The role offers flexibility and could suit someone looking to balance their career with other commitments.

Benefits include:

- On-site parking
- Team social events
- Free fruit

Hours & Flexibility

This is a permanent part-time position, with flexibility around working hours.

Applications are welcomed from candidates looking to work either:
- 15 hours per week over 2 days, or
- 22.5 hours per week over 3 days

title: Purchase Ledger Assistant
description:
Purchase Ledger Assistant

Location: Winsford

Job Type: Full time, permanent

Salary: £25,000-£30,000 depending on experience

HRGO Recruitment are recruiting a Purchase Ledger Assistant to join a busy finance team.

Working as part of the wider finance function, you will help ensure supplier accounts are accurately maintained, invoices and payments are processed efficiently, and any queries or discrepancies are resolved promptly.

The role:
- Maintain accurate and up to date purchase ledger records, ensuring invoices and accounts payable information are processed correctly.
- Reconcile supplier statements against internal records and investigate and resolve any discrepancies.
- Monitor the Goods Received Not Invoiced account, following up outstanding purchase orders, receipts and unmatched invoices.
- Process supplier payments accurately and within agreed deadlines.
- Respond to purchase ledger and supplier queries, working closely with internal departments and external contacts to resolve issues.
- Produce regular finance reports, including weekly and monthly reporting for management.
- Provide general administrative support to the finance team, including handling incoming calls and responding to routine finance-related enquiries.
- Assist with other finance and administrative activities as required.

The candidate:
- Previous experience in a Purchase Ledger, Accounts Payable or a similar finance role is required.
- A good understanding of the purchase-to-pay process, including purchase order matching and supplier statement reconciliation.
- AAT qualification or current AAT study, ideally at Level 2 or above, is desirable.
- Experience using an ERP or cloud based accounting system
- Excellent attention to detail and a methodical approach to financial administration.
- Strong communication skills and the confidence to deal professionally with suppliers and internal stakeholders.
- Good organisational and time management skills, with the ability to prioritise competing deadlines in a busy environment.
- The ability to work accurately within a high volume, largely paperless finance environment.

For further information, please contact Sophie on or email
